zh_CN: 一个机器人，一颗星球，慢慢变绿
en: One robot, one planet, slowly turning green

zh_CN: 有未应用的设置更改，放弃并返回吗？
en: You have unapplied changes. Discard them and go back?
Click a tab to switch pages

zh_CN: 编辑器内运行：窗口由编辑器控制
en: Running in editor: window controlled by editor

zh_CN: Esc 取消（手柄：View 键取消）
选择存档位开始新游戏
en: Choose a slot for your new game
Choose a slot to save progress

zh_CN: 确定删除存档 %d 吗？此操作无法撤销。
en: Delete slot %d? This cannot be undone.

zh_CN: 存档 %d 已有进度，确定覆盖吗？
游戏世界（占位）\n存档 %d · %s · 游玩时长 %s\n按 %s 保存并返回主菜单
en: Game world (placeholder)\nSlot %d · %s · Play time %s\nPress %s to save and return to menu

zh_CN: 跳过这段对话吗？（遇到下一个选项时会停下）
en: Skip this dialogue? (Stops at the next choice)

zh_CN: 这是任务页面的显示案例。正式任务内容待编辑；此处不关联场景事件或游戏进度。
en: This is a display example. Actual task content is to be edited; no world events or gameplay progress are connected.

zh_CN: 检查区域环境（示例已完成）
点击任务查看演示详情
en: Select the task to view demo details

zh_CN: 演示参考：不计入游戏进度或存档。
en: Display reference: no gameplay or save progress.

zh_CN: 确定返回主菜单吗？未保存的进度可能丢失。
en: Return to the main menu? Unsaved progress may be lost.

zh_CN: 右摇杆用于镜头，请选其他按键
en: Right stick is reserved for camera; choose another input

zh_CN: 设置未能保存，更改仍可预览或放弃。
en: Settings could not be saved. Changes can still be previewed or discarded.

zh_CN: 前往北方水源（北边的小岛）
en: Head to the north spring (the island to the north)
Clear the debris blocking the spring intake
Open the cage and free the animal
Reach the lake island and activate the station

zh_CN: 东部绿洲：浇灌枯地并救出小动物
en: East oasis: water the dry ground and free the animal

zh_CN: 北部山顶：浇灌山顶并救出小动物
en: North summit: water the summit and free the animal
Tear down the garbage wall on the south shore

zh_CN: 大海重新打开了。谢谢游玩！
en: The sea is open again. Thanks for playing!

zh_CN: 湖泊早已干涸。启动北部泉眼的水泵让水重新流向湖泊，再唤醒湖心电站。
en: The lake ran dry long ago. Start the pump at the north spring so water flows back to the lake. Then wake the lake power station.

zh_CN: 北部泉眼 / 湖心电站

en: Start the pump at the north spring

zh_CN: 长按 E 激活湖心电站
en: Hold E to activate the lake power station

zh_CN: 垃圾堵塞了土地。长按 E 清理垃圾，让绿色重新蔓延。
en: Litter is choking the land. Hold E to clear it and let the green spread again.

zh_CN: 继续清理并浇灌枯树周围的土地。土地变绿后枯树会重新长叶。
en: Keep cleaning and water the ground around dead trees. They leaf out again once the ground is green.
Press %s to activate the energy core

zh_CN: 废弃工厂里还留着能量的火种。清理工厂，用储能核心唤醒沉睡的小机器人，再把核心带回湖心终端。
en: The abandoned factory still holds a spark of power. Clear it out and wake the sleeping bot with the energy core then bring the core back to the lake terminal.

zh_CN: 废弃工厂 / 湖心终端
返回湖心终端交付储能核心
en: Return to the lake terminal with the core

zh_CN: 湖心终端已安排下一项任务：带着升级后的装备和密钥前往雷达站，清理周边环境，尝试修复并启动雷达。山地区域复苏度达到40%即可完成本阶段。
en: The lake terminal has assigned your next mission: take your upgraded equipment and key to the radar station. Clear the surroundings and attempt to repair and start the radar. Restore the mountain region to 40% to complete this stage.

zh_CN: 按 %s 尝试修复并启动雷达
en: Press %s to attempt radar repair and startup

zh_CN: 完成湖心终端的上一项任务后再处理此处环境
en: Complete the previous lake terminal mission before clearing this area
